findings.title: Execution prerequisite list can be deleted to make authority grantable
findings.evidence: verify_stage4_preflight_v1.py sets unsat = contract.get(...).get('unsatisfied_prerequisites', []) and grantable = not failed and not unsat. No implemented gate requires the prerequisite block or the exact G16/G17 entries to exist.
findings.failure_mode: Deleting or emptying unsatisfied_prerequisites while leaving all 18 design gates intact makes execution mode eligible to return 0 even though no executor exists. G11 can still pass because governance says Stage 4 NOT_AUTHORISED; grantable does not require an explicit positive authorization state.
findings.required_repair: Add a fail-closed execution-prerequisite registry gate. While executor is absent, require the exact G16 and G17 blockers and require execution exit nonzero. Later, successor authorization must replace those blockers with explicit satisfied evidence rather than deleting them. Add mutations for deleting the block, emptying the list, deleting G16, deleting G17, and replacing either with arbitrary text.

findings.title: Accepted Phase-B consumer-schema semantics remain under-bound
findings.evidence: Neither authority nor verifier contains the accepted aggregate binding, 3231 metacells, 32153 intervals, 37419 pair keys, 10552158 T5 rows, 6624289 T3 nnz, 55467544 T4 nnz, 36794 minimum-donor pairs, five-state availability vocabulary/order, or pair_gene/pair_interval axis-resolution checks.
findings.failure_mode: The correct bytes may be loaded under an incorrect axis/state interpretation. Digest custody alone cannot prove semantic interpretation by a future executor.
findings.required_repair: Add a distinct schema/consumer gate using frozen Phase-B artifacts only. Mutation-test aggregate binding, structural dimensions/counts, state vocabulary/order, pair_gene mapping, pair_interval mapping, and metacell IDs. Do not compute correspondence.

findings.title: Stage-4 authority producer still lacks post-commit Git-blob custody
findings.evidence: V64_STAGE4_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_V1.json producer records path and SHA-256 only. build_stage4_execution_authority_v1.py also emits only producer path + sha256.
findings.failure_mode: The source that generated the authority is not bound to its committed repository identity, repeating the provenance class already exposed by B6.
findings.required_repair: Add a post-commit producer blob patch/receipt and fail-closed identity check. Preserve build-time SHA history; do not pretend the producer can know its own final blob before commit.

findings.title: Pairing permutation is labelled non-required but is still execution-blocking
findings.evidence: pairing_permutation says required_for_stage4_execution=false, but it is included in REQUIRED_BINDINGS and G15 has on_failure=STOP.
findings.failure_mode: The contract simultaneously says the artifact is corroborative-only and makes its absence/mismatch block execution.
findings.required_repair: Choose one meaning prospectively: either corroborative and non-blocking, or an execution prerequisite. Keep digest verification either way, but make the authority language and gate consequence consistent.

next_action: Repair S77-S79 before any executor implementation. Resolve S80 for contract consistency. Stop again for independent audit; do not implement or run the Stage-4 executor in the same repair.
